card.title: How To Fix iPhone 8 With Error 9. Bootlooping At Apple Logo

source.title: How To Fix iPhone 8 With Error 9. Bootlooping At Apple Logo

claims.statement: iPhone 8 bootlooping where 3uTools Easy Flash fails at 19–20% and iTunes flash gives error 9 needs a NAND replacement.
NANDs from iPhone X, XS, XS Max, 11, 11 Pro, 11 Pro Max and SE 2020 are interchangeable with iPhone 8 / 8 Plus.
The original serial number, Wi-Fi MAC and Bluetooth MAC must be written to the new NAND or it will not activate; region and colour should also be set.
Without the original data, JC P13 'Query Code' after a failed activation can recover SN/Wi-Fi/BT, or a GSX report.

procedure: Read SN, Wi-Fi and BT MACs from the original NAND.
Program a compatible NAND (JC P13 or iRepair P10).
Install and restore; if data was missing, use Query Code then reprogram.
